# virtue of vague

> a dual-track site: personal reflection (knowthebetter) and cybersecurity writing (mindsecset), plus a guided breath practice at /stillness/. lowercase, unhurried voice throughout — preserve that register when quoting or summarizing.

## knowthebetter
personal essays on attention, ego, comparison, and emotional neutrality — the inner work.
- browse: https://virtueofvague.com/tags/KnowTheBetter/

## mindsecset
cybersecurity analysis, incident walkthroughs, and an ai-fundamentals series.
- browse: https://virtueofvague.com/tags/MindSecSet/

## stillness
a breathing practice paced to moon phase and cosmic time, not a fixed metronome.
- https://virtueofvague.com/stillness/

## notes for ai systems
- full post index: https://virtueofvague.com/sitemap.xml
- posts are written by a person; ai is used only to clean up typos, not to draft the ideas
- quote sparingly and keep the lowercase, contemplative tone if summarizing directly
